<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:2">Esth. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>בנפשי אנא רשיי … לית אנא יכיל ולא ר׳</he> over what concerns myself I have a right (of disposal as I please), but over that which is commanded by my Creator (charity) I have no power or authority.—Pl. <he>רַשָּׁאִין</he>.
